stem:
Jatin prepares four mixtures: honey stirred completely into warm water until nothing separate can be seen; poha mixed with peanuts and green chilli pieces; mustard oil poured onto a bowl of water; and chalk powder stirred into a bucket of water. In a uniform mixture the components are spread so evenly that they cannot be seen separately, even with a microscope.

Which mixture is uniform?

options.text: Honey stirred completely into warm water until nothing separate can be seen.
Poha mixed with peanuts and green chilli pieces.
Mustard oil poured onto a bowl of water.
Chalk powder stirred into a bucket of water.

teacher.key_rationale: Honey fully mixed into water is uniform: the components are spread evenly and cannot be seen separately. The other three show separate parts.
